arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: General Gershengorn argued the Vacancies Act limits self-appointment to first assistants.
Mr. Dvoretzky argued the statute's broad terms compel a different interpretation.
Justice Kagan questioned the practical effect of removing specific statutory language.
Justice Ginsburg referenced Senator Byrd's view on the statutory construction.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on the Vacancies Reform Act. The Board says the law blocks a nominee from acting in their own office. The company argues the statute permits this arrangement. The Court must interpret the statutory text and legislative history.
